t1.text: Fixture and FX sheets: one sheet that says who is driving each value, clears it, takes typed values and edits effects live

how.text: How to read this. Survey is today. Main is the new sheet's anatomy; Layers and FX draw its two new mechanisms out; Hosts, Heads and groups draw it everywhere it appears. Model is the decisions, the wire, the code and the open calls. Dark-only, the busk view's vocabulary — the intended pixels, not structure to copy.

agreed.text: Agreed 2026-10-07 before drawing: sheet effects are programmer effects; movement orbits the set position; FX settings are always live; the Edit toggle goes; a source mark plus a tap for the stack; one sheet for groups; a bottom sheet on the phone; Release, editor-kit controls and a head strip are in.

open.text: The six open calls were called by Chris on 2026-10-07; the answers are on Model.

agreed2.text: Also agreed 2026-10-07: carry Around current into effect templates, the live editor into the programmer, Release over a selection, held-back marks and the stack into the grid; add a busk Effects tab (instance edits, with Update template and Reset to template) and Fixture sheet… on a rig tile.
